summary.text: Michael Bowles is a Republican candidate for Alaska House of Representatives District 25 in the November 3, 2026 general election, alongside incumbent DeLena Johnson (R) and Steven Merritt (Nonpartisan).
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is a U.S. Army veteran and currently the District 1 member of the Mat-Su Borough Assembly.

paragraphs.text: Bowles served in the U.S. Army from 2001 to 2013, and earned an associate degree from the University of Alaska Anchorage and a bachelor's and a graduate degree from Liberty University.
In his survey, he said he was awarded the Bronze Star Medal for meritorious duty during a second combat tour to Iraq.
Bowles said he began a second career with the State of Alaska in 2013, working as a state OSHA industrial hygienist, as investigator for the Board of Pharmacy and as its executive administrator.
He said he and his wife started a food truck, Happy Bison Barbeque, and that his Mat-Su Borough Assembly term ends in November 2026.

His listed campaign priorities include fiscal responsibility without new taxes or debt, opposing abortion, natural resource development and economic growth, agriculture and food security, and legislative term limits.
